violations.why: The ISR can preempt the task between the writes at 25 and 27 and read the intermediate value 0x09, which the task then overwrites.
The ISR can run after the write at 19 and before the write at 27, and the task never masks the interrupt.
If v_meadow is 1, the ISR can read v_glacier between the writes at 19 and 25.
